concepts.gloss_en: heel (the lowly/foot aspect, associated with Yaakov)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences share root ע.ק.ב and are deployed with the identical meaning 'heel' — occ:746 (עָקֵב) as the heel/lowliness of Yaakov, and occ:2673 (עֵקֶב, from Deut 7:12) explicitly reinterpreted as רַגְלִין (feet/heel). Although עֵקֶב literally means 'consequence,' the Rebbe here uses it purely for its 'heel' sense in the same bechina relation, so this is variant vocalization of one 'heel' concept, not a homograph split.
